sharedDrive.name: Robotics Norway
sharedDrive.note: The shared Drive folder is limited to named members. It is not public. Each of the files below is shared so anyone with the link can view it.

documents.name: Minutes – Robotics Norway steering group meeting, 12 November 2026
documents.summary: Minutes from the steering group meeting on 12 November 2026: the charter approved, study trips to Grimstad, Odense, the US and China, the Bay Area proposal, and ideas such as one million robots in Norway by 2035.

documents.name: Charter for Robotics Norway
documents.summary: The charter for Robotics Norway: a free network with no budget, open to robotics companies in Norway and to individuals, run by a volunteer steering group with rotating leadership and administration.

documents.name: Notice and agenda – Robotics Norway steering group meeting
documents.summary: Notice and agenda for the first steering group meeting: approval of the charter, the website, and two proposed projects, A door to the Bay Area and A door to China. Date to be set.

documents.name: Minutes – Robotics Norway founding meeting, 5 November 2026
documents.summary: Minutes from the founding meeting at Startuplab on 5 November 2026: member introductions, existing initiatives, the Bay Area project, robot labs, the steering group and next steps.
